content.value_statement: Lighthouse contrast audit failures can hide actionable SEO and accessibility results. This skill gives focused checks and remediation patterns for CSS contrast problems.
actual_capabilities: Identifies Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights accessibility failures caused by contrast audit errors.
Provides search commands for filters, OKLCH, OKLAB, low opacity, and gradient text.
Suggests fixes for blend modes, transparent text, image backgrounds, and weak overlays.
Defines contrast acceptance thresholds for normal and large text.
Recommends local Lighthouse or axe verification before PageSpeed Insights checks.
limitations: Does not run Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, or axe automatically.
Does not calculate contrast ratios from screenshots or rendered pages.
Focuses on contrast-related audit failures, not all SEO or performance issues.
Requires users to adapt examples to their framework and design system.

use_cases.title: Repair a Broken Lighthouse Score
use_cases.description: Find CSS patterns that cause the accessibility score to show an exclamation mark instead of a numeric score.

use_cases.title: Prepare SEO Remediation Notes
use_cases.description: Translate PageSpeed Insights contrast failures into clear tasks for design and engineering teams.

use_cases.title: Review Contrast Risk Before Release
use_cases.description: Check overlays, gradients, opacity, and color formats before publishing a redesigned page.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Contrast Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my Lighthouse accessibility exclamation mark. Start with likely contrast audit causes and list the first checks.

prompt_templates.title: Scan CSS Triggers
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan my project for filters, OKLCH or OKLAB colors, low opacity backgrounds, gradient text, and text over images.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Safe Fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Lighthouse contrast findings and propose fixes that preserve the visual design while meeting contrast thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a Release Candidate
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the changed pages for contrast-related Lighthouse failures, then create a verification checklist for Lighthouse, axe, and PageSpeed Insights.

output_examples.input: PageSpeed Insights shows an exclamation mark for accessibility after a homepage redesign.
output_examples.output: Likely causes include transparent gradient text, low opacity cards, and image text without a strong overlay. The next step is to inspect those patterns and verify with local Lighthouse.

output_examples.input: A component uses blurred card backgrounds and white text over a hero image.
output: Increase the overlay opacity behind text.
Remove blur or blend effects from text containers.
Confirm normal text reaches a 4.5 to 1 contrast ratio.

output_examples.input: A design system uses OKLCH tokens and Lighthouse fails the contrast audit.
output_examples.output: Convert risky OKLCH or OKLAB values to supported HSL or RGB fallbacks, then retest contrast in Lighthouse and axe.

best_practices: Reproduce the Lighthouse or PageSpeed Insights failure before editing styles.
Prioritize fixes that create stable contrast across themes and browser modes.
Retest locally before waiting for PageSpeed Insights cache updates.
anti_patterns: Treating an accessibility exclamation mark as a normal low score.
Keeping transparent gradient text without a solid color fallback.
Using decorative image overlays that are too weak for readable text.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps fix Lighthouse and PageSpeed Insights accessibility failures caused by contrast audit errors.

faq.question: Does it cover every Lighthouse audit?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on contrast-related accessibility failures that can affect SEO reporting.

faq.question: Can it run PageSpeed Insights for me?
faq.answer: No. It gives a workflow and checks, but users must run Lighthouse, axe, or PageSpeed Insights separately.

faq.question: Which CSS issues does it target?
faq.answer: It targets filters, blend modes, OKLCH or OKLAB colors, low opacity, gradient text, and text over images.

faq.question: What contrast ratios should I verify?
faq.answer: Verify at least 4.5 to 1 for normal text and 3 to 1 for large text.

faq.question: Is this useful with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides clear review steps that can guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code in a project workspace.
